apiAgentsDescription: Run transcription from scripts, CLI tools, or AI agents.
askForDownloadModel: Would you like to download the model from the website
askForInstallYtdlpMessage: Do you want to install yt-dlp which is used for downloading audio from popular websites?
askForRelaunchBody: Do you want to relaunch now?
askForUpdateBody: Do you want to update vibe into version {version}?
askForUpdateYtdlpMessage: New yt-dlp version found. Do you want to update yt-dlp?
unloadModelAfterInactivityInfo: Frees memory when idle; the next run reloads the model.
zeroMeansNever: Set to 0 to keep the model loaded.
compareNeedTwo: Choose an input and at least two models
confirmExit: Do you want to exit? Unsaved changes will be lost.
agentPromptHint: Ask Codex or Claude: “Summarize my last Vibe meeting.”
crashedRecently: Since the app is crashed recently, the GPU is disabled. you can enable it in the settings.
customizeInfo: Download any supported model in ggml or gguf format (with the file extension ending in '.bin'). Transfer it to the models directory, then select from the dropdown. No need to restart 🌟
downloadDiarizeModel: Speaker diarization requires a model (~108MB). Download it now?
downloadRequiredVadModelQuestion: This transcription model requires Silero VAD. Download it before selecting the model?
exportDialogDescription: Choose what to export and how you'd like to use it.
transcribeOnCpuInfo: Slower, but avoids driver crashes and frees the GPU.
globalHotkeyDescription: The key combination dictation listens for in any app. Click the field and press a new one; pick a combo no other app uses.
hotkeyActivationPushToTalkDescription: Hold the shortcut while you speak and release it to transcribe: recording stops the moment you let go. Choose this for short notes, where nothing can keep listening by accident.
hotkeyActivationToggleDescription: Press once to start and again to stop and transcribe. The microphone stays on between presses, which suits long passages but leaves dictation listening until you stop it.
dictationIndicatorSettingInfo: Shows a small floating pill while the shortcut records, transcribes and delivers the text, so you can follow dictation with another app in front.
normalizeHotkeyOutputInfo: Collapses every run of spaces and line breaks into a single space, so the text arrives as one paragraph. Off: the line breaks and spacing are kept.
infoCancelDownload: You can cancel and download the model manually later.
infoDiarizeThreshold: Threshold for speaker recognition or consider as not detected
infoDiarization: Adds a speaker label to each segment so you can tell who said what. It needs a separate speaker model — a one-time download — and adds processing time to every transcription.
infoEnableLogs: Write logs to file. Please restart after enabling it.
infoGpuDevice: Which GPU runs transcription. Auto lets the engine choose; 0, 1 and so on pin a specific card when the machine has more than one.
infoHighGpuPerformance: Enhances graphics performance for Vibe, but will consume more system resources.
infoLlmApiKey: Key for requests to Claude, created in the Anthropic console (link beside the name). It is stored on this device and sent only to the provider.
infoManualDownload: Internet connection is required to download the AI model
infoMaxSentenceLen: Letters per line. Needs word timestamps.
infoMaxSpeakers: How many speakers should be in the file. Used for more precise recognition
infoMaxTextCtx: How much of the text already decoded the model may look back at, which keeps names and terms consistent across a long recording. More costs speed and memory; 0 leaves the engine default.
infoContextSize: How much text one AI request may carry: longer transcripts are split to fit, and a larger budget means fewer, longer requests. It must not exceed the model's real context window, or requests fail.
infoNormalizeLoudness: Better accuracy. Adds up to 8 minutes per hour of audio.
infoPrompt: Words and names the model should expect — jargon, acronyms, people's names. It biases the decoder toward those spellings; it is not an instruction, and it is capped at 1,024 characters.
infoRecognizeSpeakers: Detect speaker in each sentence and add it
infoTemperature: Higher varies the wording, lower stays literal. Try 0.4.
infoTranslateToEnglish: On: speech in any language is written out in English. Off: the model keeps the spoken language, which it usually transcribes more accurately.
infoUseWordTimestamps: Adds a start and end time to every word instead of one range per segment. Speaker labels can then switch mid-segment and subtitle cuts land on word boundaries; the transcript grows and decoding is a little slower.
infoAiTaskEnabled: On: Vibe applies this prompt to everything the task covers — each new transcript for summaries, each dictation for cleanup. Off: the model is not called and the text stays as produced.
infoApiKey: Key for the server; leave empty if it requires none.
infoBaseUrl: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible service, including /v1 if it expects it. The default is OpenAI's own endpoint; change it for a local or self-hosted server.
infoCheckForUpdates: Asks the selected channel now; a newer build appears as Update now, and nothing installs until you press it. Vibe runs the same check at startup and when you switch channels.
infoComparePickModels: Pick two or more installed models; each runs on the clip one after another and reports its own time and text.
infoCompareRecord: The same recording or file is sent to every chosen model, so the transcripts and timings can be compared directly.
infoDisplayLanguage: Changes the language of the menus, settings and messages, and the language AI summaries and notes are written in. It does not change the language transcription produces; that follows the transcription language.
infoDownloadModel: Paste a direct link to a model file; Vibe opens the download and adds the model to the installed list when it finishes.
infoFocusWindowOnFinish: Brings the Vibe window to the front when a transcription finishes, so you can read it at once. Off keeps you in the app you were using.
infoGlobalHotkey: On: the shortcut records dictation in any app, even while Vibe sits in the background. Off: dictation is unavailable; the rest of the app still works.
infoHotkeyOutputMode: Clipboard copies the text and tells you it is ready to paste. Type writes it at the cursor of the app in front, which is quicker but can be refused by apps that block simulated keystrokes.
infoLlmModel: Which model answers. Larger models read long transcripts better but respond slower, and on a paid provider they cost more; the placeholder is the provider's default.
infoLlmPlatform: Where the model runs. Ollama is local: no API key, nothing leaves the machine, but the model must be downloaded and the computer fast enough. Claude bills per request through an API key; an OpenAI-compatible server is any OpenAI-style endpoint, local or hosted.
infoMeetingHandlers: On: Zoom, Teams and Webex links open Vibe's meeting window instead of the system browser. Off: the apps' own handlers open them again.
infoMeetingHostAdd: Adds a domain to the built-in browser's allowlist: it and its subdomains may then load in the meeting window. Under Strict, everything not listed is refused.
infoOllamaBaseUrl: Where Vibe reaches Ollama, port included. Change it when Ollama runs on another machine or a non-default port; the default is http://localhost:11434.
infoOpenInVibeLink: Opens the pasted address in the meeting window's built-in browser rather than the system browser; a bare domain is tried over https.
infoPlaySoundOnFinish: Plays a short chime when a transcription finishes, so you can tell from another window that the text is ready.
infoProjectsFolder: Where saved transcripts and their media live. Changing it affects new saves only; projects already in the old folder stay there.
infoShowSpeakers: Puts the speaker's name, or its number, before each segment in the export. Only has an effect on transcripts that were diarized.
infoShowTimestamps: Adds start and end times before each segment in text, Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV and document exports. SRT and VTT always carry timing.
infoTheme: Picks the light or dark palette for the whole interface; the choice is saved and applies immediately.
infoUpdatesCurrentVersion: The version running on this device; the updater compares it with the newest build on the selected channel.
contextSizeRuleOfThumb: Rule of thumb: 64K tokens fits about 5 hours of speech; language and pace vary.
modelFileCorrupt: This model file is incomplete or corrupt
modelFileCorruptDescription: {name} failed its integrity check. Re-download to replace it.
chunkLengthInfo: Long recordings are cut at pauses into model inputs no longer than this. Lowering it reduces the memory each run needs but means more cuts; empty uses the engine maximum of {max} seconds.
modelLimitationLanguage: Recognizes only {language} speech and cannot pick the language automatically.
pinnedDeviceMissing: The pinned device {name} is not available. Reconnect it or pick another one.
pleaseEnableWordTimestamps:
Please enable word timestamps to use this option!
Also make sure to disable this option once you finished or reset the model options!
pleaseSetMaxSentenceLen:
Word timestamps also need a max sentence length — on its own this option changes nothing.
Set it to 1 for a timestamp per word, or higher to group words into lines.
resetAskDialog: Are you sure you want to reset Vibe? App data will be cleared including models files.
meetingDetectionInfo: Watches the microphone; when a supported meeting app starts using it, Vibe shows a small prompt to record the call. Nothing starts recording on its own.
autoTranscribeAfterRecordingInfo: Transcribes each recording as soon as it stops, using the current model, so the text is ready without pressing anything. The work starts immediately, which can keep the machine busy right after a call.
recordingReadyInfo: Your audio is saved. Choose a language and options when you’re ready to transcribe.
recordingDevicesLocked: Devices cannot be changed while recording.
meetingBrowserMissingLink: This link does not include a URL to open.
meetingBrowserCloseQuestion: A recording is running. Stop it before closing, or keep recording in the background?
meetingHostsInfo: Links to these hosts count as a meeting: while one is open, Vibe suppresses its own call prompt. Every https link opens in the Vibe browser with recording controls.
meetingHostInvalid: Enter a bare host name, for example meeting.example.com
browserAllowedHostsInfo: Only these domains, and their subdomains over https, may load. Everything else is refused and listed under Blocked.
browserAllowedHostInvalid: Enter a bare host name, for example meeting.example.com
browserAllowedHostSaveFailed: Could not save the allowed domains
browserBlockedHostsInfo: Hosts the browser refused. Allow one to add it to the list above and reload the page.
browserPolicyInfo: Strict blocks every origin the allowlist does not name. Trusted site lets an allowed page load its resources from anywhere, but links to other domains are still refused.
openInVibeInfo: Open an https link in Vibe's built-in browser instead of the system browser.
recordingShortcutEnabledInfo: On: the shortcut starts and stops recording from any app, even with Vibe in the background. Off: recordings start only from the app.
recordingShortcutInfo: The key combination for start and stop. Click the field and press the combo you want; pick one no other app uses.
meetPermissionInfo: Needs Screen Recording permission. Zoom and Teams work without it.
microphonePermissionInfo: Without this permission Vibe cannot capture your microphone. Grant it once in System Settings; it covers every recording, including meetings.
systemAudioPermissionInfo: Without this permission Vibe cannot capture audio playing on the Mac — the other side of a call. Grant it once in System Settings.
recordingShortcutRegistrationFailed: Could not register the recording shortcut
recordingAlreadyInProgress: Another recording is already in progress.
autoSummarizeOnFinishInfo: Runs the summary as soon as a new transcript finishes; projects that already exist are not summarized.
gpuFallbackToCpu: GPU failed to load model. Falling back to CPU.
transcribeEngineStoppedBatchStopped: The transcription engine stopped. Stopping batch.
noModelSelected: Select a model in Settings to get started
downloadDefaultModelDescription: Download the default model to start transcribing.
transcriptWillDisplayedShortly: Transcript will be displayed here shortly...
updateChannelInfo: Release is the stable line. Beta carries release candidates of the next version. Dev carries the newest builds.
updateDevBoundary: Dev builds sort below your installed version, so the dev line starts with one manual install of a dev build.
ytdlpOptionsInfo: On: when you open the link tab, Vibe checks GitHub for a newer yt-dlp at most once a week and offers it as a notice. Off: no check, and link downloads keep the installed version.
ytdlpUpdateAvailable: A new yt-dlp version is available
ytdlpUpdateAvailableInfo: Version {version} is out. Updating usually fixes links that stopped working.
ytdlpUpdateAfterFailure: The download failed. Updating yt-dlp to {version} usually fixes links that stopped working.
stableTimestampsSlowNote: Highly accurate timestamps, but around 4x slower.
translateWhisperModelNote: Whisper medium/large only; not v3 Turbo.
samplingStrategyInfo: Beam search explores more paths; greedy is faster.
greedyInfo: Top candidates in Greedy mode (default: 5) — higher = better accuracy, slower.
beamInfo: Paths explored in Beam Search (default: 5) — higher = better accuracy, slower.
stableTimestampsConfirm: Stable timestamps requires a VAD model (~1MB). Download it now?
agentInstructionsCopied: Agent skill instructions copied to clipboard
localApiUnreachable: Could not reach the local API
permissionAudioRecording: Please enable system audio recording in System Settings, then try again.
deleteTranscriptBody: Delete “{name}”? The transcript and its copy of the audio will be removed.
deleteAllProjectsBody: Delete all {count} saved project(s)? Their transcripts and copies of the audio will be removed. This cannot be undone.
dropFilesHere: Drop audio, video or a folder here
orClickToBrowse: or click to browse your files
dropToAddToQueue: Drop to add to the queue
pasteMediaLink: Paste a video or audio link
couldNotOpenFolder: Could not open the containing folder
audioCopyUnavailable: Saving a copy of the audio is not available here
saveProjectsInfo: On: every finished transcript and its media are saved in the projects folder, so they survive a restart and appear in the sidebar. Off: results stay in memory until you export them.
promptPlaceholder: Names, jargon or spellings you expect in the audio — for example: Vibe, Tauri, Whisper
fakeUpdateAvailableInfo: Developer switch: makes the app act as if an update were waiting, so the update dot and prompt can be tested. Nothing is downloaded or installed.
closeToTrayInfo: Closing the window leaves Vibe running in the tray, so global dictation keeps working. Quit it from the tray menu.
launchAtStartupInfo: Starts Vibe when you log in, so global shortcuts and meeting detection are ready without opening it by hand. The window opens as it normally does.
couldNotEnableLaunchAtStartup: Could not enable launch at startup: {error}
couldNotDisableLaunchAtStartup: Could not disable launch at startup: {error}
preventSleepInfo: Stops the idle timer from putting the computer to sleep while Vibe runs, so it stays reachable — your phone can hand off a recording to it at any time. The screen still turns off. Uses more battery.
phonePairDescription: Shows a QR code to scan with the phone's camera. Regenerating it replaces the invitation only; phones already paired stay connected.
phoneHandoffInfo: Record on your phone, transcribe on this computer.
phoneHandoffToggleInfo: On: Vibe starts the receiving endpoint that paired phones send recordings to, so a call recorded on the phone is transcribed here. Off: the endpoint shuts down and phones cannot upload until it is on again.
phoneHandoffRelayNote: Audio goes through a relay, end-to-end encrypted. Vibe must stay open here.
phoneHandoffUnavailable: Phone handoff is not available in this build of Vibe.
pairingQrCodeError: Could not render the pairing code.
scanPairingCodeInfo: Point your phone’s camera at this code, then keep the page it opens.
endpointIdInfo: Endpoint id your phone connects to
phoneWaitingForRecording: Waiting for a phone to send a recording.
phoneTranscriptSentBack: Done — the transcript went back to your phone.
revokeAllPhonesInfo: All phones must scan a new code to reconnect.
phoneAccessRevoked: Phone access revoked. Scan the new code to reconnect.
skillSectionDescription: The same instructions as a skill, ready in every session.
promptIgnoredByModel: The selected model does not use prompts. This prompt is kept for when you switch back to a Whisper model.
whisperOnlyOptionsNote: These options apply only to Whisper models. The selected model uses its own decoding settings.
speakerUncertain: May be either speaker — this line sits where two turns meet
linksSkipped: {count} of {total} links could not be downloaded
autoExportInfo: Export every transcript as soon as it finishes.
autoExportProjectsInfo: Where the app keeps its transcripts
autoExportReplaceInfo: On: a new export overwrites a file with the same name. Off: the existing file is kept and the job is reported as skipped.
autoExportNoFolderYet: No folder chosen yet; until then, files go to the projects folder
aiSummaryTaskInfo: Turn a finished transcript into a summary, notes, or a translation.
aiDictationTaskInfo: Clean up punctuation and slips before the text is typed.
aiTestInfo: Sends one short request with the current settings, so a wrong key, URL or model name shows up here instead of on your first summary.
aiTrySample: so um i think we should uh move the meeting to thursday, does that work for everyone
promptMustContainPlaceholder: The prompt needs {placeholder} somewhere, or the model never sees the text.
askPlaceholder: What was decided about the budget?
summaryOff: Summaries are off. Turn them on in Settings → AI.
cpuVariantInfo: Which build of the engine's CPU code to run. Auto detects the best instruction set; Baseline is for machines that falsely report AVX2 and crash with an illegal instruction; AVX2 forces the faster build and fails on CPUs without it.
whisperOptionsInfo: How the selected Whisper model decodes — translation, word timings, prompt, sampling, temperature and context. Defaults suit most recordings; change them when output is wrong or too slow.
audioProcessingInfo: Loudness normalization and custom FFmpeg options.
generalTrayInfo: On: closing the window hides Vibe in the tray instead of quitting, so global shortcuts and phone handoff keep working; quit from the tray menu. Off: closing the window quits, asking first if a transcription is running or results are unsaved.
generalAwakeInfo: Keeps the computer from idle-sleeping whenever Vibe runs, so global shortcuts and phone handoff stay reachable; the display may still sleep, and a laptop battery drains faster. Recording and transcribing already prevent sleep on their own.
diarizationMigrateQuestion: The diarization model changed format with the new engine. Download the new model (~108MB) now?
diarizationMigratedOff: Speaker detection is off until the new model is downloaded.
compareAllFailed: Every selected model failed, so there is nothing to compare.
meetingHandlersInfo: Register Vibe as the handler for Zoom, Teams and Webex links, so they open in the meeting window instead of the browser.
meetingHandlersUnavailable: This system does not support registering link handlers.
meetingBrowserLoadFailedBody: The page could not be loaded. Try again, or close the window?
recordingLongSilence: No sound from {name} for five minutes. Check that this is the device you mean to record.
